$comment: Lets agents inspect a bounded project directory tree without disabling project ignore rules.
title: Forge search tree tool input

path.description: Project-relative directory to inspect. Omit or use '.', '' or '/' for the project root; absolute paths are allowed only inside the project.

flags.description: Optional flags: --max-depth=N (default 2, maximum 6), --max-entries=N (default 200, maximum 500), --dirs-only. Ignore rules cannot be disabled.
